newsitem.title: USA: US Mid-West power prices steady to lower into Mon.
newsitem.headline: US Mid-West power prices steady to lower into Mon.

text.p: U.S. Mid-West spot power prices were mostly steady to lower Friday as a cold airmass moved further east, bringing some warmer temperatures and easing power demand, industry sources said.

Peak, non-firm electricity prices in the East Central Area Reliability Coordination Agreement (ECAR) eased for weekend delivery to $20.00-21.00, while Monday ECAR power was talked over a broad range of $20.00-26.00 per megawatt hour (MWh).
Next-day ECAR power was discussed at $28.00-32.00 per MWh on Thursday.
Off-peak next-day ECAR power was assessed unchanged at $12.50-14.00 for weekend and Monday delivery.

Peak ECAR power for the five business days of next week was talked loosely at $19.00-22.00, while December was pegged lower at $19.50-20.00 from $21.00-21.50 on Thursday, the brokers and marketers said.

In the Mid-Continent Area Power Pool (MAPP), peak non-firm power for weekend and Monday delivery was talked steady at $19.00-21.00 with some line-loading problems persisting despite new transmission rules, the sources said.
Off-peak non-firm MAPP power was said to have held steady at $9.00-10.00 per MWh.

In the Mid-American Interpool Network (MAIN), non-firm peak power was talked steady at $23.00-26.50 through the weekend and into Monday in the north, while the south area was assessed lower at $18.50-21.00 per MWh, the sources said.
Off-peak next day MAIN power was pegged steady at $12.00-14.00 per MWh.
Peak non-firm power prices in the Southwest Power Pool (SPP) were talked higher in the $24.00-27.00 range for the entire region from Thursday northern prices at $23.50-26.50 per MWh.
Weekend SPP power was said to be even more expensive near $30.00 for Saturday.
Off-peak prices throughout SPP were reported to be steady at $12.00-14.00, the sources said.
Peak December SPP power was said to be talked at $21.85-22.05 from near $23.00 on Thursday, the sources said.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
